summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Le Bon Clic. All 25 API endpoints tested successfully (100% pass rate). Verified OTP bypass '1234', Brevo email/SMS integration (5 email types + SMS), APScheduler cron job, PDF generation, and J-1 reminder idempotence. Fixed minor bug in contact endpoint to allow anonymous messages.

fixed_bugs.issue: Required authentication when it should accept anonymous messages
fixed_bugs.fix_applied: Added optional_user_id dependency in auth.py and updated contact endpoint to use it

passed_tests: GET /api/health - returns {status:ok, sms_dev_mode:false}
POST /api/auth/send-otp - valid FR phone (06/07) returns 200 with masked_phone and expires_in
POST /api/auth/send-otp - invalid phone format returns 400
POST /api/auth/verify-otp - bypass code '1234' returns 200 with JWT token (works for all phone numbers)
POST /api/auth/verify-otp - incorrect code returns 400
GET /api/me - with valid token returns user data
GET /api/me - without token returns 401
PUT /api/me - completes profile and triggers 2 invoice_ready emails (verified in logs: HTTP 201)
POST /api/bookings - creates booking for tomorrow, triggers booking_created email (verified in logs: HTTP 201)
POST /api/bookings - past date returns 400 'La date doit être dans le futur.'
POST /api/bookings - invalid time_window returns 400
POST /api/bookings - invalid device_id returns 400
GET /api/bookings - lists user's bookings
POST /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule - modifies date+time_window, triggers booking_updated email (verified in logs: HTTP 201), resets reminder_j1_sent_at flag
POST /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule - past date returns 400
POST /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule - unknown booking_id returns 404
POST /api/bookings/{id}/cancel - cancels booking (status=cancelled), triggers booking_cancelled email (verified in logs: HTTP 201)
GET /api/invoices - lists user's invoices (2 seeded invoices present)
POST /api/invoices/{id}/pay - marks invoice as paid
GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf - returns PDF with content-type application/pdf, size 3198 bytes (>1KB)
POST /api/admin/run-reminders-j1 - first run sends SMS+email for tomorrow's bookings, marks reminder_j1_sent_at (verified in logs: HTTP 201 for both SMS and email)
POST /api/admin/run-reminders-j1 - second run returns notified=0 (idempotence verified, no duplicate sends)
POST /api/contact - with auth stores message and returns 200
POST /api/contact - without auth stores message and returns 200 (after fix)
APScheduler startup verified in logs: 'Scheduler started (reminder_j1 cron 18:00 Europe/Paris)'
All 5 Brevo email types verified in logs: invoice_ready (2x), booking_created, booking_updated, booking_cancelled, reminder_j1
Brevo SMS integration verified in logs: OTP SMS and reminder SMS sent successfully (HTTP 201)
No crashes with missing email addresses (best-effort handling working correctly)
